BackstoryDef.title: fire attack survivor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was released from growth when facility was attacked by foes using incendiary weapons. [PAWN_possessive] recovery process was slow, [PAWN_pronoun] passed time by making art. Staying so long in hospital lead to picking up a some knowledge of medicine. [PAWN_pronoun] was left with a crippling fear of fire.
